packagingReason: The explicit files list is materially incomplete. Even with electron-builder's automatic node-file-trace, the installer cannot boot the server or run migrations because none of the server code, migrations, or compose files are included
correctionOptions: Option A — bundle everything the desktop needs to supervise the server: server build + migrations + fingerprints + prod compose + Dockerfile + report templates. Installer becomes larger; desktop can run without an external server.

Option B — desktop requires an external server (running under Docker) that the operator sets up separately. Then the installer packages only the desktop; the server is deployed via docker-compose from a separate distribution.
recommendation: Decide Option A or B before spending time on packaging fixes
